```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(fs)

# Quarto renders from the directory containing this file, whereas this notebook
# is often run interactively from the repository root. Use one stable root in
# both cases so all relative paths resolve correctly.
project_root <- if (dir_exists("data-raw/tourism")) {
  path_abs(".")
} else {
  path_abs("../../..")
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)
```

```{r}
# Folder containing the raw TRA exports.
folder <- path(project_root, "data-raw/tourism/tra-raw")

# Accept the new annual exports (for example, activity-2014.csv) and the older
# quarterly exports (for example, activity-2014-q1.csv). Underscores are also
# accepted when files have been renamed.
activity_files <- dir_ls(folder, glob = path(folder, "*.csv")) |>
  keep(~ str_detect(
    path_file(.x),
    regex("^activity[-_][0-9]{4}(?:[-_]q[1-4])?\\.csv$", ignore_case = TRUE)
  )) |>
  sort()

if (is_empty(activity_files)) {
  stop("No activity CSV files found in: ", folder)
}

# Prefer an annual file when both annual and quarterly files exist for a year.
# This prevents the same observations from being counted twice.
file_info <- tibble(
  path = activity_files,
  file = path_file(activity_files),
  year = str_extract(file, "[0-9]{4}"),
  is_annual = !str_detect(file, regex("[-_]q[1-4]\\.csv$", ignore_case = TRUE))
)

years_with_annual_files <- file_info |>
  filter(is_annual) |>
  pull(year) |>
  unique()

activity_files <- file_info |>
  filter(is_annual | !year %in% years_with_annual_files) |>
  pull(path)

expected_output_cols <- c(
  "year",
  "month",
  "address",
  "stop_activity",
  "trips",
  "n_sample"
)

standardise_month <- function(month_value) {
  month_value <- month_value |>
    as.character() |>
    str_to_title() |>
    str_squish() |>
    na_if("")

  month_map <- tibble(
    raw = c(as.character(1:12), month.abb, month.name),
    month = rep(month.name, times = 3)
  ) |>
    distinct(raw, .keep_all = TRUE)

  tibble(raw = month_value, row_id = row_number()) |>
    mutate(raw = if_else(raw == "Sept", "Sep", raw)) |>
    left_join(month_map, by = "raw") |>
    arrange(row_id) |>
    transmute(month = coalesce(month, raw)) |>
    pull(month)
}

read_activity_file <- function(file_path) {
  file_name <- path_file(file_path)
  message("Reading: ", file_name)

  lines <- tryCatch(
    read_lines(file_path, progress = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      warning("Could not read file: ", file_name, " | ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (is.null(lines)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Older exports use "State"; annual exports use
  # "Stopover state/region/SA2" for the geographic field.
  header_pattern <- regex(
    paste0(
      '^"?Calendar year"?,"?Month returned from trip"?,',
      '"?(?:State|Stopover state/region/SA2)"?,"?Stopover activity"?'
    ),
    ignore_case = TRUE
  )
  header_row <- which(str_detect(lines, header_pattern))[1]

  if (is.na(header_row)) {
    warning("Could not find the table header in: ", file_name)
    return(NULL)
  }

  header_line <- lines[seq(max(1, header_row - 1), header_row)] |>
    str_c(collapse = " ")

  expected_header_labels <- c(
    "Calendar year",
    "Month returned from trip",
    "Stopover activity",
    "Overnight trips (000)",
    "Sample"
  )

  missing_header_labels <- expected_header_labels |>
    discard(~ str_detect(header_line, fixed(.x)))

  if (!is_empty(missing_header_labels)) {
    warning(
      "Header in ",
      file_name,
      " is missing expected labels: ",
      str_c(missing_header_labels, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  footer_row <- which(
    str_detect(lines, fixed("(c) Tourism Research Australia")) |
      str_detect(lines, fixed("Tourism Research Australia"))
  )[1]

  data_start <- header_row + 1
  data_end <- if (is.na(footer_row)) length(lines) else footer_row - 1

  if (data_start > data_end) {
    warning("No data rows found after the header in: ", file_name)
    return(NULL)
  }

  data_block <- lines[seq(data_start, data_end)]

  activity_data <- tryCatch(
    read_csv(
      I(str_c(data_block, collapse = "\n")),
      col_names = FALSE,
      col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
      na = c("", "NA"),
      show_col_types = FALSE,
      progress = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      warning(
        "Could not parse data rows in: ",
        file_name,
        " | ",
        conditionMessage(e)
      )
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (is.null(activity_data)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  if (ncol(activity_data) < 6) {
    warning(
      "Expected at least 6 columns in: ",
      file_name,
      " but found ",
      ncol(activity_data),
      ". Missing columns will be filled with NA."
    )

    missing_columns <- tibble(
      !!!set_names(
        rep(list(NA_character_), 6 - ncol(activity_data)),
        str_c("missing_", seq_len(6 - ncol(activity_data)))
      )
    )
    activity_data <- bind_cols(activity_data, missing_columns)
  }

  activity_data <- activity_data |>
    select(1:6) |>
    set_names(expected_output_cols) |>
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ .x |> str_squish() |> na_if(""))) |>
    fill(year, month, address, .direction = "down") |>
    filter(
      if_all(
        c(year, month, address, stop_activity),
        ~ coalesce(str_to_lower(.x), "") != "total"
      )
    ) |>
    filter(!if_all(everything(), is.na))

  if (nrow(activity_data) == 0) {
    warning("No usable data rows remained after cleaning: ", file_name)
    return(NULL)
  }

  activity_data |>
    transmute(
      year = as.integer(parse_number(year)),
      month = standardise_month(month),
      address = as.integer(parse_number(address)),
      stop_activity = as.integer(parse_number(stop_activity)),
      trips = parse_number(trips),
      n_sample = as.integer(parse_number(n_sample)),
      source_file = file_name
    ) |>
    drop_na(year, month, address, stop_activity)
}

activity_results <- tibble(
  file = activity_files,
  data = map(activity_files, read_activity_file)
)

failed_files <- activity_results |>
  filter(map_lgl(data, is.null)) |>
  pull(file)

if (!is_empty(failed_files)) {
  warning(
    "Some files could not be parsed and were skipped: ",
    failed_files |> path_file() |> str_c(collapse = ", ")
  )
}

activity_all <- activity_results |>
  pull(data) |>
  compact() |>
  bind_rows()

if (nrow(activity_all) == 0) {
  stop("No usable activity data were found.")
}

activity_clean <- activity_all |>
  mutate(
    month = factor(month, levels = month.name, ordered = TRUE)
  ) |>
  arrange(year, month, address, stop_activity) |>
  select(all_of(expected_output_cols))

# Retain only SA2 codes represented in the tourism-region lookup.
tourism_region <- read_rds("data-raw/tourism/tourism_region.rds") |>
  mutate(sa2_code_tra = as.integer(sa2_code_tra))

filtered_activity_clean <- activity_clean |>
  semi_join(
    tourism_region |> distinct(sa2_code_tra),
    by = c("address" = "sa2_code_tra")
  ) |>
  rename(sa2_code_tra = address)

activity_clean |>
  write_csv(path(folder, "tourism_activity_raw.csv"), na = "")

filtered_activity_clean |>
  write_csv(path(folder, "tourism_activity.csv"), na = "")

# Keep records supported by both a non-zero trip estimate and a non-zero
# survey sample, then save them as a separate analysis-ready dataset.
tourism_activity_filtered <- filtered_activity_clean |>
  filter(
    trips != 0,
    n_sample != 0
  )

tourism_activity_filtered |>
  write_csv(path(folder, "tourism_activity_filtered.csv"), na = "")

# Save package datasets in the format supported by data() and LazyData.
package_data_folder <- path(project_root, "data")
dir_create(package_data_folder)

tourism_activity <- tourism_activity_filtered
tourism_activity_name <- read_csv(
  path(folder, "stop_activity_names.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(stop_activity = as.integer(stop_activity)) |>
  select(stop_activity, name) |>
  arrange(stop_activity)

save(
  tourism_activity,
  file = path(package_data_folder, "tourism_activity.rda"),
  compress = "xz"
)
save(
  tourism_activity_name,
  file = path(package_data_folder, "tourism_activity_name.rda"),
  compress = "xz"
)

# Helpful checks.
glimpse(filtered_activity_clean)
head(filtered_activity_clean)

filtered_activity_clean |>
  count(year, month, name = "rows") |>
  arrange(year, month) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

The `tourism_region` dataset maps `sa2_code_tra` values to their corresponding
tourism-region names.

```{r}
stop_activity_names <- read_csv(
  path(folder, "stop_activity_names.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
tourism_activity <- read_csv(
  path(folder, "tourism_activity.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Summarise trips for each named stopover activity.
tourism_activity |>
  inner_join(stop_activity_names, by = "stop_activity") |>
  summarise(
    trips = sum(trips, na.rm = TRUE) * 1000,
    n_sample = sum(n_sample, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(year, stop_activity, name)
  )
```

```{r}
# Find total trips for each tourism region.
tourism_region |>
  left_join(tourism_activity, by = "sa2_code_tra") |>
  summarise(
    trips = sum(trips, na.rm = TRUE) * 1000,
    n_sample = sum(n_sample, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(state, region, ws_id, sa2_code_tra)
  )
```
